name: dsh-plugin-session-search-patched
description: Unofficial patched engine for the optional session search: swaps the shipped SQLite session-query engine for one with a bounded index, and falls back to the shipped engine when the guard fails or the patched engine fails to load or start.

meta.title: Session search (patched engine, unofficial)
meta.description: Replaces the engine of the optional session search with a bounded-index build of the same engine. Only for DSH 0.2.2-rc.3 and 0.2.2-rc.5; anywhere else the shipped engine keeps serving.

author: anvilsong
